questions.passage:
A student has written these notes about two fictional delivery routes:
• Route Elm is 8 kilometers long.
• Route Bay is 12 kilometers long.
• Both routes start at the same depot.
questions.prompt: The student wants to emphasize a difference in route length. Which choice best accomplishes this goal?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Route Bay is 4 kilometers longer than Route Elm.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Both routes start at the same depot.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The depot is the starting point for two routes.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Route Elm and Route Bay are both delivery routes.

explanation.short: Subtracting 8 from 12 states the difference in length directly.
explanation.key_evidence: Subtracting 8 from 12 states the difference in length directly.
explanation.why_correct: Subtracting 8 from 12 states the difference in length directly.
explanation.detailed: Subtracting 8 from 12 states the difference in length directly.

choice_analysis.A: Subtracting 8 from 12 states the difference in length directly.
choice_analysis.B: This statement describes a shared feature, not a difference in length.
choice_analysis.C: This statement identifies the common starting point but omits lengths.
choice_analysis.D: This statement identifies a shared purpose, not the length difference.

choices.label: B

explanation.key_evidence: The first sentence identifies water collecting at the door, and the second describes a drainage response.
explanation.why_correct: The first sentence identifies water collecting at the door, and the second describes a drainage response.
explanation.detailed: The first sentence identifies water collecting at the door, and the second describes a drainage response.

choice_analysis.A: The first sentence identifies water collecting at the door, and the second describes a drainage response.
choice_analysis.B: The drainage channel directly responds to the water problem.
choice_analysis.C: The text does not compare explanations for rainfall.
choice_analysis.D: The text gives no definition or contradiction of a definition.

questions.passage: The first trial used a wide paper strip. ______ the second trial used a narrow strip, allowing the class to compare the two widths.
questions.prompt: Which transition best signals the contrast between the trials?

choices.label: A
choices.text: By contrast,

choices.label: B
choices.text: For example,

choices.label: C
choices.text: Therefore,

choices.label: D
choices.text: Similarly,

questions.source_set: Original development fixtures — not official test questions

explanation.short: By contrast marks the difference between a wide strip and a narrow strip.
explanation.key_evidence: By contrast marks the difference between a wide strip and a narrow strip.
explanation.why_correct: By contrast marks the difference between a wide strip and a narrow strip.
explanation.detailed: By contrast marks the difference between a wide strip and a narrow strip.

choice_analysis.A: By contrast marks the difference between a wide strip and a narrow strip.
